## Judgment

### Expected-drift set
Corrected expectation: sweet16, petunia, avina, hermes plus groot@dualie. groot@forge has zero drift. groot@rk3588 is N/A on x86_64.

The four NixOS hosts drift because dddfa16 re-encrypted secrets/common.yaml (added the groot@dualie recipient). The file's bytes changed, so the sopsFile store path and sopsFileHash in the sops-nix manifest change for every host that enables nix-nexus.nix.signing. groot@dualie drifts because of the new modules/user/bincache-home.nix HM module.

### Actual vs expected
The sets are equal. verify-drift.sh reports DRIFT on sweet16, petunia, avina, hermes and groot@dualie, none on groot@forge, N/A on groot@rk3588.

I walked each derivation tree pairwise to confirm the cause, not just the set.
- sweet16, petunia, avina, hermes: the only differing derivation is manifest.json. In every host the differing manifest fields are exactly builder-key sopsFile and sopsFileHash. The change reaches the toplevel only through the activate and dry-activate scripts. petunia's manifest uses structuredAttrs, and I checked it there too: same two fields, plus the common.yaml input source. Nothing changed in nix.conf, the bincache-push hook script, units or anything else. The lib/bincache-push.nix extraction is a no-op, as intended.
- groot@dualie: the diff is the new HM module only. home-manager-files gains the bincache-push hook file at .local/share/nix-nexus/bincache-push, the sops-nix.service user unit, and its default.target.wants link. The activation script gains the sops-nix restart block. No other derivation differs.
